Date: Mon, 9 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Priority heatmap: exec asks + closure plan

Team — attaching a heatmap that consolidates exec asks from last week's xfn sync and the standing roadmap exceptions list. Goal: have closure plan for the top 6 items before the Tuesday QBR (2028-07-16).

Quick notes:
- Column A = ask origin (exec/partner/PM)
- Column B = current owner (please update)
- Column C = blocker (capacity/legal/infra)
- Column D = suggested mitigation and ETA

Asks from me: please do a row-level update in priority-heatmap-v2.xlsx by EOD Wednesday with the following: owner confirmation, single-sentence risk, and a concrete next step (PR link/Doc/Slack channel).

Attachments: priority-heatmap-v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), qbr-exec-asks-annotated.pdf (pdf)

Marissa Cole
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

Marissa — thanks, got it. Quick updates on the rows I own:
- Model A quantization profile: blocked by infra slot availability; I can free a small window Thu morning if that helps. Next step: schedule tune and validation (PR: github.com/redwood/ops/pulls/412). ETA: 2028-07-13.
- Eval suite for hallucination regression: currently in draft; need test vectors from Research (pinged @Ava). ETA: 2028-07-15 unless we get test vectors sooner.

I'll update the sheet by EOD Wednesday. Vivek — I marked the infra blocker as high risk, can your team confirm slot availability?

—Karthik

Thanks all — a couple of clarifications from the exec desk before you finalize rows:
1) For partner commitments (Acme Health), the exec asks are non-negotiable on delivery windows; please flag any ask that slips >3 business days so I can escalate.
2) On the QBR talking points, we need 2 bullets per item: impact statement + measurable success metric. Add those into the sheet under column F.

Jonas — can you prod CS to confirm the partner-side acceptance criteria for the two Acme integrations (Selena is looped).

I will not sign off on any burst spend without a concrete ROI paragraph in the sheet. If Finance is needed, loop Erin in early.

—Lauren

- Integration A: end-to-end latency <= 250ms (p95), documented test harness, signed acceptance form.
- Integration B: embeddings parity within 2% of baseline on the benchmark suite; docs and runbook delivered.

Selena — please confirm that the above matches Acme's internal acceptance criteria or flag items by EOD Friday. Procurement (copied) is tracking the commercial milestone tied to Integration B.

Excellent progress — thank you. Final checklist before I fold this into the QBR pack on Monday 07/16:
- Everyone: complete your row-level owner confirmation + impact metric in column F (Lauren's ask) by EOD Friday 07/13.
- Karthik: run quantization in Thu window and paste validation artifacts + PR link in column G.
- Vivek: confirm whether Finance needs to approve burst and provide a short cost estimate in the sheet.
- Jonas / CS: confirmation from Selena (or an explicit discrepancy) by EOD Friday.

I'll assemble the QBR slide draft Sunday and share for 24-hour review. If any item cannot meet these asks, mark it as "escalate" in column H and include the minimal mitigation to keep the partner live.
